set.prevailing_wage_basis: CDLAC Regulations adopted December 10, 2025, Section 5106 ranking tiebreaker: the bond allocation does not itself impose prevailing wage; the cost-adjusted tiebreaker reduces the request by 15% only for projects paid in part out of public funds and subject to a separate legal prevailing wage requirement (plus 3% for a project labor agreement or apprenticeship and health care commitment). Wage obligations come from other layered public funds. https://www.treasurer.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/approved.pdf
set.audit_note: prevailing_wage_trigger false means the CDLAC allocation alone does not trigger state prevailing wage; layered HCD or local funds usually do.

reason: 2026 rounds all closed and no 2027 schedule posted; CDLAC regulations treat prevailing wage only as a tiebreaker factor arising from other public funds.
